guarantees.claim: When digest_size_i equals SHA2_256, txcnt_eq_blksz is asserted (1) iff the lower BlockSizeBitsSHA256 bits of txcount are zero and txcount is not all zeros.
When digest_size_i equals SHA2_384, txcnt_eq_blksz is asserted iff the lower BlockSizeBitsSHA512 bits of txcount are zero and txcount is not zero.
When digest_size_i equals SHA2_512, txcnt_eq_blksz is asserted iff the lower BlockSizeBitsSHA512 bits of txcount are zero and txcount is not zero.
For any other value of digest_size_i, txcnt_eq_blksz remains 0.

assumptions.claim: txcount has width at least BlockSizeBitsSHA512 bits to allow legal bit slice txcount[BlockSizeBitsSHA512-1:0].
assumptions.risk: Synthesis or simulation failure due to out-of-bounds bit select if txcount is too narrow.

uncertain_points.claim: If digest_size_i can take a legal value other than SHA2_256, SHA2_384, or SHA2_512 (e.g., SHA2_224), the default branch sets txcnt_eq_blksz to 0, which may incorrectly indicate block size equality.
uncertain_points.cond: digest_size_i is a valid but unlisted hash mode
uncertain_points.risk: Incorrect block size detection could cause wrong padding, digest corruption, or security protocol failure.
